name: Timesheet
description: Official Timesheet time tracking server: start, pause and stop timers, log past work, manage projects, todos, tags, expenses, absences and teams, and pull statistics, reports and exports (Excel, CSV, PDF). Needs a Timesheet API key.
author: Timesheet

TIMESHEET_API_TOKEN.description: Timesheet API key, created in the web app under Integrations > API Keys.
